Everglades Bicycle Club Saturday Ride

Coral Gables, FL

Everglades Bicycle Club Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Coral Gables, FL. It meets every Saturday, 7:00 am, starting at Ponce de Leon Middle School. Expect about 20–60 miles, A/B/C groups.

About the Everglades Bicycle Club Saturday Ride group ride

Miami's oldest road club. Saturday training rides leave the middle school across from UM in several pace groups. New riders are asked to read the ride guide first and sit at the back on their first ride. The club also runs a short beginner ride on the second Saturday.
